stories.title: Exploratory GlycA-lipid metabolic profiles and long-term cardiovascular and mortality associations in inflammatory bowel disease
stories.takeaway: UK Biobank metabolic clustering linked a higher-GlycA/lower-lipid profile to increased cardiovascular and mortality risk in IBD.
stories.what_happened: Investigators combined proton-NMR metabolomics, CatBoost-SHAP and K-means clustering, then assessed adjusted outcomes; the higher-inflammation cluster showed elevated composite CVD and heart-failure associations in both Crohn's disease and ulcerative colitis.
stories.why_it_matters: Highlights the potential value of systemic metabolic phenotyping in inflammatory bowel disease risk research.
stories.caveat: Single-cohort observational analysis with modest, method-dependent cluster separation; no causal or clinically validated risk classification.

stories.title: Tibetan dark tea alleviates ulcerative colitis through TXNRD-dependent ferroptosis and gut microbiota-metabolite modulation
stories.takeaway: A preclinical colitis study associated Tibetan dark tea with reduced intestinal injury, altered ferroptosis signaling and microbiome remodeling.
stories.what_happened: Researchers tested tea constituents in LPS-stimulated macrophages, DSS-treated mice and colonic epithelial ferroptosis models; reported TXNRD-linked protection and increased Akkermansia abundance.
stories.why_it_matters: Provides a testable example of intersecting intestinal inflammation, cellular redox regulation and microbial ecology.
stories.caveat: Cell and mouse experiments cannot establish dietary treatment efficacy, dose or safety in people with ulcerative colitis.

stories.title: Integrated gut microbiome and plasma metabolomic profiling reveals distinct biological signatures of damjeok syndrome
stories.takeaway: Gut microbial composition and circulating metabolites differed between participants classified with damjeok syndrome and controls.
stories.what_happened: Full-length 16S profiling covered 114 participants and plasma metabolomics a 90-person subset, identifying 33 differential microbial species and 35 discriminatory metabolites.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates integrated microbiome–metabolome profiling of gastrointestinal symptom-associated phenotypes.
stories.caveat: Cross-sectional associations cannot establish causality; the syndrome definition and signatures require independent validation in broadly recognized clinical cohorts.

stories.title: A split RNA-guided Cas9 system for PAM-independent and cis-cleavage-free nucleic acid detection
stories.takeaway: A modular Cas9 assay detects several nucleic-acid types without the conventional PAM restriction for double-stranded DNA detection.
stories.what_happened: Splitting guide RNA into spacer and scaffold modules enabled picomolar amplification-free detection and attomolar sensitivity with amplification; researchers tested HPV16 and miR-21 in clinical specimens.
stories.why_it_matters: Broadens molecular-diagnostic engineering options, including potential applications to colorectal cancer biomarkers.
stories.caveat: Reported analytical sensitivity and specimen testing do not yet demonstrate robust point-of-care clinical performance across settings.

stories.title: Nanobody mimicry of a GPCR recognition site disrupts human C5a-C5aR1 signaling
stories.takeaway: Engineered nanobodies neutralized C5a-mediated receptor activation by structurally mimicking its receptor-binding interface.
stories.what_happened: Cell-based signaling assays and crystallography showed high-affinity C5a binding and competition with the receptor recognition surface.
stories.why_it_matters: Offers a protein-engineering strategy for investigating complement-driven inflammation and therapeutic antagonism.
stories.caveat: This is molecular and cellular evidence; efficacy, pharmacology and safety in patients have not been established.
